ability.plain: Look at your opponent's hand. You may deal 2 damage to one of your spies. If you do, choose 1 card for your opponent to discard.

ability.immediately: The two spies may swap spaces. If they do, the spy that was not attacked becomes the defender. The original defender recovers 1 health.

ability.afterCombat: Deal 1 damage to the defending spy and each fighter adjacent to the defender.
